title: Akiyama Mizuki — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So this is about what you want to do on your birthday?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, she told me to think about what I want to do...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I couldn't think of anything... And I totally forgot about it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well then, is it any surprise that Ena's upset?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: B-But Ena was the one that was just all, “You should think about it,” and never said anything else!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Like, An! If you were in my shoes, what would you do for your birthday?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh, me? Hmm...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
If I could do anything, then...
Maybe a pajama party at mine or Kohane's place!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Whoa, that sounds so fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Riiight? It'd be the best!
We could graze on snacks and chill out until the wee hours of the morning.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A pajama party...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That reminds me, Mafuyu stayed over at Ena's place that one time...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That was just because Ena wanted Asahina to be her model for an art assignment.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now now, we're all welcome to our own interpretations♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks a bunch, An! You've given me the best idea!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And fear not, Li'l Bro! I'll reply to Ena really soon!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Mizuki, wait!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Gone just like that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, as long as it turns out to be a fun birthday, I guess that's all that matters.
bgm_area00005
That night
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And that's how I decided to hold the Happy Birthday Mizuki Pajama Party!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Pajama party...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's a type of slumber party, yes?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Friends gather at one person's house and wear pajamas while chatting and enjoying snacks.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why do they wear pajamas?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess that way you feel more comfortable and have more relaxed conversation.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. So, does the fact you came to tell us about this pajama party mean that we're invited too?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Luka, you're spot on♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I was thinking we could have the party here in SEKAI so that no one misses out. Would that be okay?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If that's okay with you and the others, then we don't mind either.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And... I'd also like to experience a pajama party...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: M-Me too...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But, we don't have any pajamas...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm one step ahead of you!
Ta-da! Take a look at this!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is this...a book of clothes?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's called a “catalog”. It's a book that tells you what sorts of clothes you can buy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I work part-time in a clothing store, and they're about to start selling a bunch of cute pajama sets♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If you pick out some pajamas you like from here, I'll get exactly what you want!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: B-But... It's your birthday, Mizuki. Is this okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's absolutely okay!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm super excited for this party, and I'm gonna take loads of cute pictures of you all wearing my store's products!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe... You're already having fun, and it's not even your birthday yet.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha! Events like this are fun even to plan!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
C'mon, let's all look at the catalog!
Tell me anything that catches your eye!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, don't mind if I do.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Seriously? Dodging the question for a week and now suddenly all full of enthusiasm...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's good to see Mizuki did actually want to celebrate, isn't it Ena?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you sure the reason you didn't get a reply wasn't because you were half-asleep when you brought it up?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: N-No way... I don't think...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm glad Mizuki thought of a way to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, guys! Lemme get your input!
Miku's stuck on what color pajamas to pick.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Got it, got it. Which set?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Mizuki, happy birthday!
Hehehe, I got you a special coupon for my cafe♪ Please drop by—as a customer, this time!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mizuki, happy birthday♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ena told us all about the pajama party! Like how you guys ate a bunch of snacks and talked loads☆ I hope it was super duper fun!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, it must have been since Ena told us with so much excitement.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Mizuki, happy birthday!
I'm glad I got to say it on the day as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too! We did give you that “special something” the other day, but let us take this chance to celebrate properly.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sometime this evening, you'll be getting a goodie bag of your favorite food!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Serve with a bowl of steaming hot rice and enjoy!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Kohane, Toya & Akito
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: At first you said you couldn't think of how to celebrate, but I heard that you held a pajama party in the end. Was it as fun as you hoped for?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was a party with Ena and the others, so there's no way it could not be!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Where does that confidence come from...?
I mean, Ena seemed satisfied, so I guess it went well?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. That's good to know.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll have to ask about the party when we next meet.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes, that's right! Mizuki, let's talk sometime soon, at school or anywhere! See you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Mizuki.
I was confused to receive a photo of a mysterious mountain of pajamas, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You must have been excited about your birthday.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's good to be excited about one's birthday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Akiyama! Do you feel sufficiently celebrated?!
If you need more birthday wishes, I will happily oblige anytime!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Mizuki.
I was surprised when you said you wanted to do a pajama party...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And I didn't expect you to even have us wear the pajamas you got.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, that was no trouble really. It was for Mizuki's birthday after all.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Though, we did have to strike a bunch of poses for all those photos...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That was kinda embarrassing...
But, I think Mizuki enjoyed it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're right. When we were eating our snacks, Mizuki was looking at the photos fondly.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Weren't you, Mizuki?
Also, send me those photos, please.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Man, people were wishing me a happy birthday all day, from the second the clock struck midnight.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And my party was amazing!
I got so many pictures of Kanade and the others looking adorable in their pajamas♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I have plenty of photos to look at and smile for a while.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It really was fun...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehehe. I'm gonna have some pleasant dreams tonight!
